name: Tunnel
concept: A corridor of light frames pulls the eye to one point; the artist is always at the end of the tunnel.
object: 7 square portal frames edged in LED, receding from over the crowd to upstage
photoMoment: All seven frames chasing toward the artist in white, shot from the back of the room down the tunnel.

elements.note: Square frame, LED edge both faces. Frames 1-3 over the deck, 4-7 over the crowd at 4.6 m clear.

acts.name: Silhouette
acts.state: Only the upstage frame lit, artist backlit inside it.
acts.light: One paper-white backlight, everything else black.

acts.name: Chase
acts.state: Frames chase on the beat toward the stage (back of room first).
acts.light: Paper white, red on the downbeat of each bar.

acts.name: Collapse
acts.state: The three stage frames tilt off-axis (10 degrees) so the tunnel breaks.

acts.name: Run-out
acts.state: Frames re-align and strobe in sequence; CO2 on the last hit.
acts.light: Full white, blackout on the last word.

buildNotes: Frames 4-7 hang over the crowd, so they must clear 4.6 m (ceiling 5 m). Frames 1-3 tilt on two hoists each. In-game: one frame mesh, emissive edge material with a per-instance chase offset.
